name: Avoca wool scarf
where: Trinity College Gift Shop or Avoca, Suffolk Street
about: A soft wool scarf woven in Ireland by Avoca, a weaving company with roots going back to the 1700s. It is a classic Irish keepsake.
tip: Check that it is woven in Ireland and look at the wool content on the label.

name: Irish whiskey
about: Teeling is a distillery in Dublin, a city that has been making whiskey for centuries. A bottle is an easy way to take home a taste of the city.
tip: Compare the standard bottling with small limited editions to choose the one you want.

name: Claddagh ring
about: A traditional Irish ring showing two hands holding a heart topped with a crown. It symbolizes friendship, love, and loyalty, and it comes from the fishing village of Claddagh near Galway.
tip: Check that the silver is stamped with a hallmark or purity mark.
